name: City 17
note: Fan work: City 17 from Half-Life 2, rendered by the same engine as chicago.html and portland.html. Nothing is surveyed and no game assets are used - tools/make-city17.py generates city17-osm.json (terrain, river, canals, streets, blocks, the Combine walls) from a seed, and this file holds the districts, landmarks, viewpoints and the sky. The geometry is this project's own, modelled from the silhouettes. Half-Life 2 and City 17 belong to Valve. Positions are [lat, lon] against the arbitrary projection origin below; 1 degree of longitude here is 74,491 m, so the map is about 4.4 km across.
attribution: City 17 is fan work: geometry generated by tools/make-city17.py. Half-Life 2 and City 17 © Valve. No game assets used.

districts._: [name, hex colour, base height, tallest, box as [lat south, lon west, lat north, lon east]]

el._: the razor train runs on a viaduct across the city, east to west

landmarks.name: The Citadel
landmarks.info: Assembly of the Universal Union. Over two miles of it, driven into the crust like a blade dropped from orbit, standing in the trench its flattening fields chewed out of the districts that were here. The hull shifts without warning. At the apex the dark energy link tears at the sky, and you can see it from every street in City 17, which is the point of it.

landmarks.name: Gunships
landmarks.info: They circle the cordon all day. You learn not to look up at them.

landmarks.name: Overwatch Nexus
landmarks.info: A civic block, plated over and crested. Everything that happens in the district is decided in there.

landmarks.name: City 17 Trainstation
landmarks.info: Where everyone arrives. The trains come in full and go out empty, and the screens in the plaza explain why that is a kindness.

landmarks.name: Trainstation Plaza
landmarks.info: The square outside the station: benches nobody sits on, a screen on a mast, and a checkpoint at every exit.

landmarks.name: Plaza screen
landmarks.info: A second screen, on the prospect running east. It is showing the same thing as the first one.

landmarks.name: North Checkpoint
landmarks.info: A gap in the outer wall with a field across it. You are scanned going both ways.

landmarks.name: East Checkpoint
landmarks.info: The gate on the east road. The queue starts before first light.

landmarks.name: Canal Checkpoint
landmarks.info: Where the road out follows the canal south. Very few people are cleared through it.

landmarks.name: West Checkpoint
landmarks.info: The freight gate, beside the rail yard.

landmarks.name: Cordon Pylon East
landmarks.info: One of the generators standing in the cleared ground around the Citadel. It hums at a pitch that stops conversation.

landmarks.name: Cordon Pylon West
landmarks.info: The pylons ring the exclusion zone at even spacing. Nothing grows underneath them.

landmarks.name: Cordon Pylon North
landmarks.info: The tallest of the ring, on the north side of the cordon.

landmarks.name: Route Kanal
landmarks.info: The concrete channel running south out of the city. If you were leaving without permission, you would be leaving this way.

landmarks.name: Canal Works
landmarks.info: Pumping houses and sheds along the channel, mostly still working, nobody quite sure who for.

landmarks.name: Rail Yard
landmarks.info: Where the razor trains are made up. The yard runs all night.

landmarks.name: Overgrown Park
landmarks.info: One of the few blocks with trees left standing, on the grounds that removing them was nobody's assignment.

combine._: the occupation: walking striders, manhacks, dropships with troop pods, armoured carriers, street barriers and sentry posts

smog._: low-lying industrial haze over the city, seen from above
